answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a 20-unit fee, burned on entry, and posts a payment signal on the registry, where paid identities carry a saffron badge. An honest agent pays 20 units once and keeps its reward undiluted. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 100 x 20 = 2,000 units, all burned, before any can earn. A burst of saffron badges stands out like flags on a knoll, so peers audit the cluster before rewards flow; the tax is never refunded.
